name: ClickSync
description: Logs every click and release while OBS records and saves them with exact video timestamps for the Click Sampler Vegas plugin.

obs-host.name: OBS Host
obs-host.description: Address of the obs-websocket server (OBS: Tools > WebSocket Server Settings).

obs-password.name: OBS Password
obs-password.description: Leave empty if authentication is disabled in OBS.

output-dir.name: Output Folder
output-dir.description: Where the .json files are saved. Empty = Documents/ClickSampler/Sync.
